summary: Retested the targeted bug fix on /suppliers 'Existing Purchasing Prices in SAP (read-only)' panel for Product ID P27175. Real supplier names now display correctly instead of 'Unknown SAP Supplier'. Negative case and quick regression of local assignments/master list also verified.

integration_issues.issue: Minor race condition observed only when Product ID input is changed and 'Load' clicked again before the previous fetch resolves - the stale prior response briefly renders under the new Product ID label before eventually being corrected/overwritten by the correct response for the new ID. Not observed under normal single-load usage; only surfaced when rapidly changing input immediately after clicking Load without waiting for prior request to finish. Low severity - recommend aborting/ignoring stale requests via request sequence guard or AbortController in a future pass.

action_items: Bug fix VERIFIED: P27175 now correctly shows 'M/s Prime Pack' (INR 0, muted, 'Code 1' badge) and 'HAMIDI EXPORTS' (INR 3.5, green 'Released' badge) instead of 'Unknown SAP Supplier'.

Optional (low priority, non-blocking): add request-sequencing/AbortController guard in SuppliersPage.js's Load handler to prevent a stale SAP price-spec fetch response from rendering when the Product ID input is changed and Load re-clicked before the previous request completes.
critical_code_review_comments: Core fix confirmed correct: supplier_name is now sourced from CND_SUPPL_ID PropertyValuation Description field and displays properly in UI with correct fallback logic.
Minor race-condition risk in fast sequential Load clicks (see integration_issues) - not a regression from this fix, likely pre-existing async state pattern, but worth noting for future hardening.
